method: Direct inspection of the four saved final-code Chrome screenshots after computed-layout assertions passed.

screenshots.finding: The 1440px reader is centered and fills nearly the full page; title, scope disclosure, navigation and opening prose are legible with no clipped edge.
The complete three-panel graph, English labels, Bengali caption and detailed Bengali alternative description are visible and aligned.
At 390px the title, scope panel and Bengali prose reflow cleanly without hidden text or horizontal scrolling.
At 390px all three graph panels and every mathematical line remain visible; the image scales to the container rather than becoming a cropped scroll region.

limitations: This is deterministic browser and direct screenshot inspection, not a claim of external human certification.
